source_known.branch_definition: Known source straight and inlet miter wall; receiver outlet and straight excluded

estimated_contact_classes.local_receiving_observation: qualified receiver supports or previously confirmed estimated target material chart; no bridge/unknown load is passed as receiving load

probe.directions: Two4s signed curvature cycles on materials0..7 after raw non-source front contact; evidence uses transmitted/tracked probe field during candidate contact
probe.posterior_support: curvature probe support ends at material node8, source mode starts after node15; physical servo unchanged
probe.clock_rule: Advance the same two4s cycles only with current raw front contact, joint tracking and transmitted previous probe within0.02/m of request; pause and fade probe to zero off-contact

runtime: D:/Anaconda/envs/mujoco/python.exe; MuJoCo3.2.7 NumPy1.23.5 SciPy1.13.1; OPENBLAS/MKL/OMP threads1
scope: Given all-source exit pose; stationary-source front release, contact/probe/wrap, then whole-body transfer and rolling
initial_definition: Exact original Step1 N_SHAPE physical t0 qpos/qvel/ctrl; all21 on source, no receiving pre-wrap; fresh data loaded exactly as Step1 runner, no intermediate checkpoint or joint replay

local_feedback.initial_preload_policy: Preserve posterior given grip before capture; allow physical support-preserving posture/slip, no source feed/roll command.

probe_trigger: First front material0..7 contact inconsistent with known source, before cylinder qualification; two4s signed cycles at0.18/m
probe_duration_reason: Acquire both probe directions during the initial contact-to-wrap interval; old late-start14s directions do not protect this ordering. New source-start preregistration before any dynamics.
theta_estimation: Circular phase = polar angle - winding_sign*2pi*axial/pitch, winding_sign=+1; subtract known front-only axial lead from nominal phase; original coherence, bounds and rates unchanged.
input_boundary: Robot poses/joint telemetry and unlabeled contact point/normal/full world force/signed gap; known finite source; rough receiver prior. No receiver/elbow labels, true target axis/radius/mesh into controller.
common_pair: Same given initial, controller, prior, sensor rules, probe, local modes, frequency, duration and safety; only global write permission differs in the final comparison.
all_source_start_gate: Offline truth:all21 source envelope and target/elbow zero contact; online:all21 known source geometry and source load90..110%weight, allqvelmax<.03 for2s before any S advance. Full stabilization remains in logged t0 timeline.
rear_support_policy: Select the contiguous known-source geometry/contact component with >=0.5N known-source normal load and greatest winding; require >=4 materials and >=180deg. Count known-source and persistent source-seen adjacent bridge contact vertical force, excluding qualified receiver. Require >=40%weight before receiver capture; fail after0.25s invalid. Preserve old tail-suffix diagnostics, initial90..110%,2s/10s and all threshold values.

acceptance.successful_causal_chain: Real contact before evidence-driven geometry writes; bounded probing and wrap may overlap estimation; actual loaded wrap and small commanded/tracked motion before whole-body feed, all21 transfer then sustained motion.
acceptance.source_support_criterion: Contiguous known-source/observed persistent bearing component, >=4 materials and180deg winding, source normal>=0.5N and retained vertical>=40%robotweight before receiving capture; motion/slip reported, no12mm/12deg stop.
acceptance.numeric_criteria_origin: Inherited A16 physical envelope and50s/40mm/90deg sustained-motion diagnostics chosen for development reproducibility, not user hard numbers; final paired values will be registered after full development evidence.

failure_policy: Record every started case, fail/save if stabilization/acquisition/support/physical limits fail; no replacement later start or pose replay. Geometry-only success is insufficient.
first_run_policy: Exact original initial retains its limited geometry/static review; require independent current-controller review with explicit initial binding and immutable code/physics snapshot before one diagnostic.
authorization_basis: User explicitly authorizes necessary correction and continued validation after preserving common failures; no repeated permission required; current-version independent result review remains pending
revision_reason: User corrected rolling scope and original initialization: normal advance/rolling after the placed t0 is allowed. Withdraw no-feed-before-capture, changed initial, fixed-phase6 and replacement execution patches. Preserve all48 prior starts as historical failures/partial evidence. Directly restore Step1 complete release coordination, with rough prior and contact-driven G/C instead of target truth.
scientific_change: Independent G guides -> fixed-material native curvature C -> separated local fields -> bounded original20-hinge servo. New source-hold/release/wrap/post-capture phase chain is a development revision, not an outcome of formal paired trials.

native_curve_projection.activation: After source stability; alpha uses8 curvature-integral coordinates, beta14, S only after capture
native_curve_projection.direction_solver: SLSQP on20 native curvature-integral modes, with per-command20deg/s joint bounds,2mm C-node step, NativeCCD clearance plus original-algorithm known-source collision; exact feasible nonincreasing-objective backtracking
native_curve_projection.canonical_material_metric: Fixed sigma=j*64.5mm in every phase,256 cells. Post preserves Step1 native q integration and represents identical native integrals via the fixed-sigma right inverse; spatial station is separate
native_curve_projection.canonical_C_decoder: Native hinge FK registered at one measured bearing body. Bishop reconstruction is separately named diagnostic
native_curve_projection.previous_commanded_C_phase_initializer: Only C geometry targets blend from private FK of previous commanded geometric C at wrap entry; independent G uses previous G and never actual fore-body FK

validation_order: One physical-t0 T_UPDATE diagnostic first; preserve any failure. Separate final 2 conditions x frozen/update G after continuous action evidence.

phase_coordinates.alpha: front release only, first8 hinges; freezes at measured first front non-source contact; source feed and roll zero
phase_coordinates.beta: front wrapping only, first14 hinges; source feed and roll zero
phase_coordinates.S: whole-body transport, starts only after measured front capture

controller_input_boundary: Immutable given source setup; known source branch, rough receiver cylinder; robot joint telemetry and one measured bearing pose; unlabeled contact point/normal/force. No true receiver mesh or offline truth path into planner.

kinematic_solver.geometry_query: Private known source plus receiver cylinder inferred ONLY from registered rough axis/radius/centerline and known source end plane; NativeCCD plus original-algorithm known-source check, no integration

source_known.branch_definition: Known source straight and inlet miter wall; receiver outlet and straight excluded

source_axis_balance.measured_non_source_loads: Existing unlabeled world contact forces, classified only against known source; source friction loads are not credited
source_axis_balance.scope: Geometric C only during alpha/beta; immutable independent G, original native integral and original local front/probe/source-grip servo chain retained

acceptance_scope: All prior full-transfer/rolling requirements retained. Acquisition rear rolling requirement removed because human explicitly requires stationary source before capture.

focused_corrections.source: Old12mm/12degree precapture motion guards become diagnostics; no commanded source feed/roll before actual bearing capture
focused_corrections.phase: Front joint tracking controls pace; head world error remains logged. Wrap can continue while identification/probes accumulate.
focused_corrections.capture: Allow prior-cylinder wrap chart confirmation; require actual candidate receiving vertical load>=40%robotweight,2s wrap persistence plus0.5s loaded commanded/actual fore motion evidence before whole-body feed.
focused_corrections.execution: Same source grip, curve-guided C optimization/explicit local fields before capture; same Step1 native curve/rolling/material mapping after capture; this diagnostic tests the prior cutoff without assuming optimizer superiority.
focused_corrections.gate: Local necessary checks and frozen reproducible files; no independent per-version approval required by final contract

transmitted_command_history.geometric_component: Fixed native20 coordinates, linear blend by the exact common transmitted fraction
transmitted_command_history.local_component: Sent total minus sent geometric; requested local fields and separate transmitted probe remain logged
transmitted_command_history.posterior_boundary: Existing measured source joints only, with compensating preload preserving given total source command

phase_progress_policy.rates: Original registered maxima, no increase above baseline
phase_progress_policy.common_fraction: Still filters native command; not a separate phase clock multiplier

downward_contact_relief.scope: Pre-capture M0..M7 non-source contacts with aggregate worldFz<0 per material
downward_contact_relief.aggregation: Sum normal load per rod; sum normal-load-weighted measured normal Jacobians, then normalize once per rod
downward_contact_relief.limitations: This is a new software force policy; it does not establish actual pressure relief, physical probe delivery, wrap or source holding

command_aware_clearance.command_constraints: Measured planes min(-0.8mm,previous_command_gap-0.1mm); extra2mm command-node motion. Original source-original collision remains in geometric checks and final common filter.
command_aware_clearance.current_local_change: Still protected by unchanged total command filter
command_aware_clearance.preload_baseline: Existing virtual penetration of servo equilibrium command is preserved as the filter already does; no absolute command collision requirement is added.

contact_entry_chart.axial_origin: Prescribed G head goal relative rough-cylinder axial coordinate

contact_entry_chart.native_radius: Immutable known-source calibrated node radii shifted by rough radius minus known-source radius; only existing outer C boundary blend

receiving_domain.lower: Known source miter plane intersected with prior cylinder, minus20mm conservative prior margin

local_C: Original B1 receiving radial deformation +/-2mm and late-source0.4/m mode; observation uses permitted pose/unlabeled contacts and applied G frame. Bounded two-direction probes added after real front contact.
